Magnets.name: Special Magnet
Magnets.description: Attracts ALL specials to any alive target with this troll enabled

Magnets.name: Tank Magnet
Magnets.description: Attracts ALL tanks to any alive target with this troll enabled

Magnets.name: Witch Magnet
Magnets.description: All witches when startled will target any player with this troll

Magnets.name: Projectile Magnet
Magnets.description: Makes all projectiles (biles, molotovs, pipes, tank rocks) go to player

Infected.name: Swarm
Infected.description: Swarms a player with zombies. Requires swarm plugin

Infected.name: Vomit Player
Infected.description: Shortcut to sm_vomitplayer. vomits the player. Can also be used periodically, constantly vomitting on them

Infected.name: Goo
Infected.description: Spawns a spitter puddle underneath them

Infected.name: Sticky Goo
Infected.description: Slows the player down in goo. Doesnt work.

Infected.name: Instant Commons
Infected.description: Spawns 30 zombies directly behind player and swarms them.

Infected.name: Smart Charge
Infected.description: Waits until the player is alone and has no obstructions and then charges

Projectiles.name: Rock Dropper
Projectiles.description: Drops a rock on their head.

Projectiles.name: Car Splat
Projectiles.description: Smash a player with a car

Projectiles.name: Bad Throw
Projectiles.description: Player drops throwables on throw, and biles/molotovs themselves

Projectiles.name: Molotov Bath
Projectiles.description: Drops a molotov at their feet. Checks if safe to do so.

Items.name: Throw It All
Items.description: Player throws their item(s) periodically to a nearby player

Items.name: Spicy Gas
Items.description: Gascans, propane/oxygen tanks players pick up just ignite. Crazy.

Items.name: No Pickup
Items.description: Prevents a player from picking up ANY (new) item. Use ThrowItAll to make them drop

Items.name: UziRules / AWP Smells
Items.description: Picking up a weapon gives them a UZI or AWP instead

Items.name: Primary Disable
Items.description: Player cannot pickup any weapons, only melee/pistols

Items.name: Dull Melee
Items.description: Player's melee weapon does 0 damage (based on %). Headshots still instant kill.

Items.name: Randomize Clip Ammo
Items.description: Randomly changes their clip ammo downwards

Items.name: Nerf Gun
Items.description: Makes all damage dealt by player 0

Items.name: CameTooEarly
Items.description: When they shoot, random chance they empty whole clip

Items.name: Slot Roulette
Items.description: Randomly chooses a different item slot for the player.

Chat.name: iCantSpellNoMore
Chat.description: Chat messages letter will randomly changed with wrong letters

Chat.name: No Profanity
Chat.description: Replaces some words with random phrases

Chat.name: Vocalize Gag
Chat.description: Prevents player from sending any vocalizations (even automatic)

Chat.name: Voice Mute
Chat.description: Mutes a player from talking. Same as /mute, but will last until they actually leave

Chat.name: No Rushing Us
Chat.description: Decreases player speed everytime they yell hurry up

Health.name: Damage Boost
Health.description: Makes a player take more damage than normal

Health.name: Temp Health Quick Drain
Health.description: Makes a player's temporarily health drain very quickly

Health.name: Slow Drain
Health.description: Will make the player slowly lose health over time

Health.name: KillMeSoftly
Health.description: Make player eat or waste pills whenever possible

Health.name: Reverse FF
Health.description: Reverses all damage to attacker on friendly fire

Health.name: Dep Bots
Health.description: Makes bots heal a player, at any cost.

Movement.name: Slow Speed
Movement.description: Sets player speed to 0.8x of normal speed

Movement.name: Higher Gravity
Movement.description: Sets player gravity to 1.3x of normal gravity

Movement.name: Inverted Controls
Movement.description: Swaps the movement controls (forward/sides/jump/crouch) and swaps reload & shove

Movement.name: Stagger
Movement.description: Like if an explosion goes off, slaps you into a stun.

Movement.name: Randomize Angles
Movement.description: Randomly change their angles, confusing them

Movement.name: Randomize Velocity
Movement.description: Randomly change their velocity, making them fly uncontrollably around the map

Misc.name: Gun Jam
Misc.description: On reload, small chance their gun gets jammed - Can't reload.
subnotes: Use "Throw It All" to throw their items

Misc.name: No Shove
subnotes: Will still visually shove survivors, but will not affect them

Misc.name: No Button Touchie
Misc.description: Prevents a player from pressing any buttons (elevator, horde, etc)

Misc.name: Shakey Camera
Misc.description: Extremely shakes their camera. It's horrible.
